description: This file defines the PeriodsTimeProvider class which implements a time-based notification schedule based on calendar days, with configurable start and end periods for two notifications within a year.

classes.name: PeriodsTimeProvider
classes.description: Provides the next notification time based on calendar day periods within a year.

methods.name: getNextTimeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset in milliseconds until the next notification based on the current day of the year.
